notes:
REF-BM-10: Tag entry is a plain text field with no existing-tag autocomplete.
REF-BM-14: #tag is accepted only as generic FTS punctuation and is not restricted to the tags field.
REF-BM-15: Basic AND/OR/NOT works, but parenthesized grouping is not parsed or preserved.
REF-BM-20: Bulk actions omit a user-facing mark-read action, though marking unread is available.
REF-BM-23: Notes can be written but Markdown is neither rendered nor shown in a bookmark view.
REF-BM-24: HTML snapshots are saved, but PDF targets are not downloaded and stored as PDFs.
REF-BM-25: No Internet Archive snapshot support is implemented.
REF-BM-32: No persistent personal display settings for default sort, item count, or font size are implemented.
